title: Composer's Assistant 2 — the isolated Modal worker, proven over HTTPS (Wave Q — Model Discovery, items 11–12 and 23)
definitionOfDone: real musical input → real model inference → real symbolic output, through the deployed endpoint that the platform will call, not on a developer machine. Two calls, two passes.

deployment.image: modal.Image.from_dockerfile(services/composers-assistant-worker/Dockerfile) — python:3.10-slim, torch 2.0.1+cpu, transformers 4.31.0, tokenizers 0.13.3, numpy<2, miditoolkit 1.0.1, portion 2.6.2; release zip sha256-verified at build; only *.py + licence files + the large model unpacked
deployment.buildTimeSmoke: the image only exists because a real infill on a synthesised three-track MIDI produced notes during the build (128 notes over 8 measures, 12.45 s, verdict PASS in the first build log; repeated on the target_inst rebuild)
deployment.resources: cpu=4, memory=8192 MB, no GPU (a 192M fp32 T5 infilling eight bars is a CPU job), timeout 1800 s, max_containers 2, scaledown_window 300 s
deployment.secrets: music-ai-worker-runtime (shared runtime), then composers-assistant-worker-token (dedicated MUSIC_AI_WORKER_TOKEN, generated randomly on this machine, written to the git-ignored .env.local as COMPOSERS_ASSISTANT_2_API_TOKEN and to the Modal secret, never printed; rotated 2026-09-09)
deployment.deployLog: two deploys: the first built the image in 82.83 s after the pip/curl/smoke layers (App deployed in 126.756 s); the second, adding target_inst, rebuilt and re-smoked in 91.23 s

howProven: a Modal function (scratch script, not committed) holding only the endpoint secret called the public URL exactly as the platform will: GET /health without a token, GET /health with it, then POST /infill twice with a real PDMX MIDI uploaded from this machine. The bearer token never left Modal or reached a terminal.

input.content: brass ensemble — trumpet(56), trombone(57), tuba(58), horn(60), drums; 64 measures; the same file as runs 1/1b/1c of the local proof

unauthenticated.reading: 401 — the gate is on in the cloud

licence.weights: MIT (in-release license.txt; no rights claimed on outputs per disclaimer.txt)
licence.trainingData: PD/CC0/CC-BY/permitted MIDI per disclaimer.txt; Mutopia-dominated per acknowledgments.html

task.kind: infill: given every other track, write the target track over the window

account.note: No post-generation constraint is applied inside the worker; the platform's contextAwareComposer passes do that so every provider is judged after the same enforcement.

coldStart.firstProbe: the first probe hit a cold container: unauthenticated /health 7.65 s, authenticated /health 11.89 s (770 MB fp32 weights loaded and sha-verified), infills 8.55 s and 5.98 s HTTP (3.88 s / 5.42 s inference)
coldStart.secondProbe: warm: 0.32 s / 1.09 s, infills 8.41 s / 6.29 s HTTP (7.88 s / 5.78 s inference)
coldStart.note: the two probes sampled different outputs for the same seeds (71 vs 129 output tokens for the tuba task) — CPU T5 sampling on a different host is not bit-reproducible across machines; the seed fixes the stream on one machine, not across them. Recorded, not hidden.

qualityReading.tuba, seed 13, T 1.15: 48 notes, 4 distinct pitches (39–44), every measure covered; a slow bass part in a low tuba register, harmonically static — the same character as local run 1b, not a collapse (a collapse is one pitch).
qualityReading.trumpet, seed 7, T 1.0: 39 notes, 7 distinct pitches, correct trumpet register; a repeating 64/59 figure — the bar-to-bar repetition the local proof already noted.
qualityReading.verdict: Real inference, real notes, real account. Quality is a tournament question, not a probe question.

platformWiring.client: artifacts/api-server/src/lib/composersAssistantClient.ts — COMPOSERS_ASSISTANT_2_API_URL + dedicated COMPOSERS_ASSISTANT_2_API_TOKEN (the shared MUSIC_AI_WORKER_TOKEN is refused by design); https required; identity from /health attached to every infill result so ca2ResultRefusal judges against what the container verified
platformWiring.catalogue: MUSIC_PROVIDERS entry COMPOSERS_ASSISTANT_2, SHADOW_ONLY — configured in this environment, still unavailable for routing; the shadow-routing test proves configuration cannot promote it
platformWiring.targetAddressing: worker gained target_inst (GM program 0–127, 128 = drums) resolved after CA2's own track cleaning, so a tournament can name the same part across providers that parse MIDI differently; both cloud runs used it (resolved to CA2 tracks 2 and 0)

honestLimits: CPU only; no GPU figure exists for this model and none is needed at this size.
Two calls on one classical brass score. This proves the deployment and the wire contract, not musical quality.
Cross-machine seed reproducibility does not hold (see coldStart.note); the tournament must therefore run N seeds per task and never compare single samples.

The scratch probe script that made these calls is not committed (it holds nothing secret, but it is not a platform surface); the committed path is composersAssistantClient.ts, tested against a mock and used by the tournament runner next.
